description: rust-anything (github.com/erkamyaman/rust-anything) for DeepSeek Harness: mcp__rust_anything__* tools that analyze a repository, scaffold the Rust crate, record the original's behavior, diff/build/bench/gate the port and lift a whole app, plus ra_status / ra_cli / ra_install / ra_surface / ra_bootstrap (toolchain bootstrap driven by `doctor --json`), a port-board page and a tool-surface switch.
